page_notes: Yellow legal pad page, Jan 2001 – Feb 2002, with two undated entries at the bottom (To Kill a Mockingbird, Hitty) presumably 2002. Under the RLS 'Short Stories' entry, two story titles are printed small in caps ('A Night's Lodging', 'THE SUICIDE CLUB'); kept within that entry. Tolkien's three LOTR volumes share one author line, with 'Jan. 02' beside Fellowship and 'Feb. 02' beside The Two Towers; kept as one entry.
